messages:
acme_integration: Hey team — after upgrading our integration to the latest SDK (2.4.3) some tool calls are returning successfully but the runtime reports missing required function arguments. Example: 
acme_integration: <request-id: req_0a1b2c3d> runtime returns HTTP 200 but payload contains error:
```
InvalidFunctionArguments: missing required keys: ["customer_id", "order_items"]
```
acme_integration: We only started seeing this after the SDK bump. json_mode="structured" for these calls. Repro curl below. Pls escalate — customers are retrying and costs are spiking. :grimacing:

support_jen: Thanks — can you paste the raw request body you send and the exact runtime response (headers + body)? Also include X-Request-ID if available.

acme_integration: Sending logs: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-open-2b",
    "json_mode": "structured",
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"create order"}],
    "functions": [{"name":"create_order","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"order_items":{"type":"array"}},"required":["customer_id","order_items"]}}],
    "tool_call": {"name":"create_order","arguments": {"customer_id":"cust_123","order_items":[{"sku":"X1","qty":1}]}}
  }'
```
acme_integration: runtime response snippet (body):
```
{"id":"resp_zzzz","status":"ok","tool_call":{"name":"create_order","arguments":{}} , "errors": ["InvalidFunctionArguments: missing required keys: [\"customer_id\", \"order_items\"]"]}
```

eng-joe: Hmm. The request shows arguments present but runtime got an empty object. Two possibilities: (1) something upstream is stripping keys (proxy or sanitizer), (2) SDK changed serialization for nested objects in 2.4.3 and we double-encode which runtime fails to parse and falls back to empty object.
mike_s: I dug into SDK changelog — 2.4.3 introduced a sanitize step that drops keys matching /^internal/ and also coerces objects into strings for certain Content-Type combos. Could be a collision if the integration sets custom headers. Do you set any proxy or middleware that mutates JSON body?
acme_integration: No proxy at our side, just the SDK client. We do set a small middleware that compresses payloads. We did see a header `Content-Encoding: gzip` — maybe runtime rejects and strips body?
eng-joe: Devops, can you check ingress logs around req_0a1b2c3d? I want to see raw payload arriving at runtime.
devops-bot: ingress-proxy alert: increased 4xx/5xx ratio 2026-03-17T10:12Z - 10:16Z for route /v1/chat, spike correlates with SDK 2.4.3 client IPs. Sample log available for req_0a1b2c3d: {"raw_body":"H4sIAAAAA..." , "content_encoding":"gzip"}
mike_s: That matches — gzip plus SDK stringification could produce a compressed stringified JSON inside JSON if headers mismatch. Runtime expects raw JSON when json_mode="structured". If body arrives as base64/gzip or double-encoded string, the argument parser returns {} and emits the missing-keys error.
support_jen: For now, workaround: downgrade SDK to 2.4.1 or disable client gzip middleware. Can you verify if disabling compression makes calls succeed?
acme_integration: Will test disabling compression now. Also attaching X-Request-ID for follow-up: req_0a1b2c3d and req_0a1b2c4e.
acme_integration: Quick test result: disabling compression -> tool args appear correctly and call succeeds. Re-enabling -> missing args again. So it's reproable.
eng-joe: Good repro. Action items: (1) escalate to runtime parsing eng to make parser more defensive and return a helpful error instead of silent empty args; (2) patch SDK pipeline to avoid stringifying objects when Content-Encoding present; (3) add telemetry for double-encoded payload detection.
mike_s: I'll open an SDK hotfix PR to revert the sanitize behavior and add a guard for gzip. ETA ~2 hours for PR + canary.
support_jen: I'll notify the customer success team and advise customers to temporarily disable client-side compression or pin SDK to 2.4.1. Also create a billing note — retries may incur extra charges; we can review for credits case-by-case.
acme_integration: Thanks all. Please keep me updated on ETA for the SDK patch, and we need a runtime fix to avoid silent data loss.
eng-joe: Noted. I'll add a quick runtime change to log a structured parse warning when arguments parse to empty despite non-empty incoming payload. That should make debugging easier if this recurs.
support_jen: escalating to oncall-eng now: @eng-joe @mike_s :thumbsup:
acme_integration: Appreciate the quick response.
